recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Applying the seed's original category wording literally would now undo later Applied OO decisions; any future move between Observation.code and Observation.category should be handled by a new work-group decision.
issue_request: FHIR-46418 was an Applied/Persuasive OO request to re-work the R6 Observation Vital Signs profiles: remove LOINC magic-value wording, move the then-described interoperability category to category, add profile-specific LOINC value sets with preferred Observation.code bindings, rename the page and base profile, move the base-profile link prominently, and update examples.
initial_application: The Jira says the work was pre-applied in git 71babbf5ac. Source history shows 71babbf5ac7b plus follow-up FHIR-46418 commits through e1802f1bca changed the vital-signs IG, examples, profiles, and value sets, including fixes for value-set expansion.
additional_context: The inspected files are active build inputs through source/fhir.ini, source/observation/list-Observation-packs.xml, and implementationguide-Observation-vitalsigns.xml. After the seed application, FHIR-45617 and FHIR-49953 explicitly revisited the category-vs-code design and left the standardized vital-sign LOINC codes in Observation.code; commit 66a80b5fef2c applied that reversal. FHIR-44798 later replaced magic-code wording with Interoperability Standard Code wording.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. Current source uses interoperability-standard terminology, keeps the standard LOINC code in Observation.code per the later final decisions, has preferred Observation.code bindings to the relevant vital-sign value sets, titles the base profile Vital Signs Base Profile, titles the IG page Observation Vital Signs Profiles, links the base profile prominently, and includes examples with vital-signs category plus Observation.code codings.

related_jiras.note: Requested the Observation Vital Signs page rename that FHIR-46418 said it completed.
Rejected the category-based breaking change and required guidance plus preferred Observation.code bindings.
Requested moving the vital-sign profile design back to code and was resolved as handled by FHIR-45617.
Added point-in-time scope guidance and replaced magic-code wording with Interoperability Standard Code.
Later simplified the FHIR-46418-created vital-sign code value sets without changing their role.
